project: Aayush Raj Portfolio - Awwwards-Tier Engineering Rehaul
description: Redesign and elevate the portfolio into an award-winning showcase with 100% genuine backed data, real GitHub links, fluid physics-based cursor, tactile micro-interactions, and architectural precision.

userStories.title: Ground Data & Real GitHub Repositories
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see 100% genuine projects with real GitHub links to Aayush-2825 repositories and accurate trade-offs so that the credibility of the engineering work is undeniable.
acceptanceCriteria: data/projects.ts includes real GitHub repo links for viewproof, pjmb, Swabhimaan-2, and blog
No unverified TODO placeholders in user-facing project summaries
Technical decisions and trade-offs are grounded in real architectural reasoning
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: Verified genuine GitHub repo links added, zero unverified TODO placeholders, next build passed.

userStories.title: Awwwards-Grade Spring-Driven Cursor & Magnetic Micro-Interactions
userStories.description: As a desktop user, I want a smooth, physics-based target cursor that magnetically snaps and morphs with action hints over interactive elements so that the interface feels alive and tactile.
acceptanceCriteria: Target cursor follows mouse with smooth spring physics
Cursor morphs to display contextual action pills ('EXPLORE', 'VIEW', 'COPY', 'TERMINAL') on hover
Gracefully disables on touch/mobile devices and under prefers-reduced-motion
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: TargetCursorFallback mounted in PortfolioShell with spring physics, contextual hover action pills, and useSyncExternalStore.

userStories.title: Architectural Grid Crosshairs & Corner Registration Marks
userStories.description: As a design-conscious viewer, I want architectural hairline grid borders with corner registration crosshairs (+) across major sections to give the site a distinctive blueprint-editorial aesthetic.
acceptanceCriteria: Corner crosshairs (+) render at section borders without causing horizontal scroll or layout shift
Consistent spacing and hairline border styling matching token #0A0A0B and white/[0.08]
Responsive across mobile (360px) and wide desktop (1400px)
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: CornerCrosshairs component built and deployed across Hero, DOZO, Projects, LayerMatrix, Education, and Contact.

userStories.title: Enhanced DOZO Realtime Dispatch Simulator & Packet Telemetry
userStories.description: As an engineering evaluator, I want an interactive dispatch simulation that lets me trigger mock bookings across service types and visualize packet routing with live latency metrics and procedural audio.
acceptanceCriteria: DOZO dispatch simulator allows selecting services and triggering real-time dispatch cycle
Animated SVG telemetry bus moves packets across nodes with active step feedback
Procedural Web Audio packet sound plays when audio is enabled
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: Interactive state machine with service selector, active node bus, procedural sound synthesis, and payload viewer.

userStories.title: Interactive Full-Stack Layer Matrix with Code Dossier
userStories.description: As a technical interviewer, I want to explore the six architectural layers (Client, Gateway, State, Realtime, Security, Infra) to see exactly which real projects touch each layer and inspect production code patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Layer Matrix enables selecting any layer to filter and highlight implemented projects
Displays real architectural code snippets for each layer
Smooth transitions with zero CLS
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: LayerMatrix equipped with interactive tab switches, real code snippets, project links, and corner crosshairs.

userStories.title: Project Architectural Inspector Modal with Interactive Dossier
userStories.description: As a hiring manager, I want to click any project card to open a full architectural inspection dossier with data flows, technical trade-offs, and GitHub repo links.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking any project card opens the architectural dossier modal
Dossier contains verified problem, architecture diagram, decision trade-offs, and GitHub link
Keyboard accessible (Esc to close, Tab focus trapping)
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: Accessible modal with Escape listener, trade-offs, challenges, GitHub repo links, and CornerCrosshairs.

userStories.title: Command Palette (Cmd+K) & Terminal Quick Access Polish
userStories.description: As a power user, I want instant keyboard access to search sections, copy contact info, open GitHub repos, and run developer shell commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Cmd+K opens command palette with quick navigation and copy actions
Backtick (`) opens developer terminal drawer with functional commands ('help', 'projects', 'dozo', 'stack', 'contact')
Polite procedural audio clicks when enabled
Typecheck and build pass
userStories.notes: Added GitHub repository direct actions to CommandPalette and 'github/repos' command to TerminalDrawer.

userStories.title: Production Verification & Performance Audit
userStories.description: As a production engineer, I want the entire site to pass strict TypeScript checking, next build --webpack, and responsive mobile audit.
acceptanceCriteria: next build --webpack passes with zero errors or warnings
All routes (/, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /opengraph-image) generate cleanly
No horizontal overflow at 360px viewport
progress.txt updated with final delivery proof
userStories.notes: Production build passed in 4.2s. ESLint passed with 0 errors. All static pages emitted.
